prompt:
Create a complete high-fidelity desktop UI concept image at 1600x1000 landscape for Molis Work PROJECT HOME, concept C “Room to begin”. Supplied onboarding screenshot anchors its composition: extremely open field, precise little type, functional content concentrated off-center toward LOWER LEFT, with sentence-like single-line input. Keep this meaningful restraint rather than enlarging everything. Latest user instruction changes colors to main product: main field #ffffff, sidebar #f8f9fb, charcoal #272932, secondary #60636f, subtle violet #6262d6. No green tint, no brown, no cream. No photograph, illustration, cards, boxes, dashboard or giant calendar numeral.
STRUCTURE: 220px restrained left sidebar with project identity “Molis Work · 开发预览”, active 项目首页, nav Goals, Sessions, Feed, Artifacts; small settings footer. 32px topbar in main. The main canvas feels like an open room in typography. High in upper right around x1200 y130, a very small date “09 / 12” and beneath “星期六”, balanced with a very thin 40px violet horizontal line. No hero heading at top. The most important cluster begins at x360 y500, around the lower-left golden-ratio focus of the main area, width 600px. Main short poetic text exactly “留一点空白，\n让新的事情发生。” at a refined 32px Chinese sans-serif; not giant typography, line-height about 1.6. Below it a small quote “工欲善其事，必先利其器。” and attribution “孔子 ·《论语》”; tiny carousel pause/arrows integrated next to attribution.
About 45px below, a single actionable Goal cue, modest: violet hollow point + “从这里继续” followed by readable underlined “体验新的 Goal 工作区 →”. It occupies one line, not a card. Below this cue the sentence-like composer “我想” then a long underline field placeholder “说说你想看到的变化…” and a small right arrow at the end. Tiny helper says “草稿已保留 · Agent 即将接入”. The input should clearly read as interactive, not decorative underlining.
On the far right at x1180 y740, three recent work traces rendered as a small open text footnote (not cards), heading “最近的足迹”, then tiny “今天 · 体验新的 Goal 工作区”, “昨天 · 接通终端与目标信息”, “周四 · 留下第一份工作记录”. A small “展开记录 →” under these. Preserve most of the upper middle canvas untouched; an intentional low focal point and unequal spatial weights create poetry. Fewer borders, aligned baselines, realistic precise readable UI. All requested information present, no fake metrics. No concept title, notes, annotations or watermark.
